dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: Parry %s twice and he knows your guard, they say. After that it does you no good.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: Block %s two times, he learn ya. Den ya guard is nothin'. Dem say.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: Parry %s twice an' he got ya figured! Den ya guard's no good! Dey say!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s can smell blood a long way off. Don't go near him bleeding.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s smell blood far, far. Bleed an' he find ya.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s sniffs out blood! Bleed near 'im an' he comes!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s keeps wolves. They come when he calls.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s got wolves. He call, dey come.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s got a wolf pack! Whistles an' dey come runnin'!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: You won't creep up on %s. He sees everything.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: Nobody sneak on %s. He see all.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: Can't sneak on %s! Eyes in da back of 'is head!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: Spells hardly touch %s. He hunts the ones who cast them.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: Magic barely touch %s. He kill da casters.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: Magic slides off %s! He hunts witches, dat one!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s goes for the fallen. Stay on your feet.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s finish da ones on da ground. Stay up.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s kills ya when ya down! Don't fall near 'im!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s prays before every fight. Close to death, he gets back up.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s pray to somethin'. Near dead, he get strong again.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s prays! Nearly dead an' he gets 'is wind back!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s wears iron head to foot. Slow, but hard to hurt.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s all iron. Slow. Hard to hurt.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s in iron all over! Slow, but ya can't hurt 'im!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s throws rocks. Don't stand off at a distance.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s throw rocks far. Don't stand back.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s chucks rocks! Stay back an' ya get one in da head!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s carries a shield. Hit him from behind.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s got a shield. Hit from behind.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s got a big shield! Go round da back!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: Fists and hammers hardly shake %s.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: Fists, hammers, nothin' shake %s.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: Punch %s an' ya break ya hand!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s is slow on his feet. You can outrun him.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s slow. Run an' he no catch.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s is slow! Run an' 'e'll never catch ya!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s is drunk more than he's sober. He misses a lot.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s always drunk. Miss lots.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s is always drunk! Swings at nothin' half da time!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: Beat %s near enough and he'll pay you to let him go.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: Beat %s near dead, he pay ya. Den run.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: Beat %s an' he'll throw coin at ya an' run!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s runs at the sound of a gun.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: Bang near %s, he run.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: Shoot near %s an' he runs off!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s charges with his shield down. Get out of the way when he lowers it.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s charge wit' shield. Move when he lower it.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s charges ya wit' 'is shield! Jump aside!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s smashes the ground. Be off your feet when he does.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s smash da ground. Jump when he do.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s slams da ground! Jump or ya fall!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s throws his axe from a long way off. A shield is the only thing that stops it.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s throw axe far. Only shield stop it.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s throws 'is axe! Only a shield stops it!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s grabs and throws. Don't let him get close.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s grab an' throw. Don't get close.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s grabs ya an' throws ya! Keep away!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: That's a gun! I'm not dying to a gun!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: Dat's a gun! Not me, not me!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.talk.jaymoski: Stand still! Dere's two of ya...
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: Dere's two of ya! Which one?
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: Not yet. I'm not done yet.
Give me strength, one more time.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: Not yet! I got more in me!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: Wait, %s! Take it, take all of it, just let me go!
Enough! Here, %s, coin! I was never here!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.talk.jaymoski: Wait, %s! Take coin! Let me go!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: I know how you block now, %s.
Twice was enough, %s. I've seen your guard.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.talk.jaymoski: Two time enough, %s. I see ya guard.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: I seen how ya block, %s! Not again!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: You left a trail, %s. I followed it.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: I smell ya, %s! All dat blood!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: Did you think I wouldn't see you, %s?
news.jaymoskingdoms.captain.learned.fire: %1$s of %2$s is back from the fire that should have killed him. They say no flame bites him now.
news.jaymoskingdoms.captain.learned.shot: %1$s of %2$s is back, one eye under a patch, and he carries a shield against shots now.
news.jaymoskingdoms.captain.learned.blun: %1$s of %2$s is back with an iron jaw where his own was broken.
news.jaymoskingdoms.captain.learned.blad: %1$s of %2$s is back, stitched up, and harder to cut than before.
news.jaymoskingdoms.captain.learned.magi: %1$s of %2$s is back with one pale eye, and spells hardly touch him now.
news.jaymoskingdoms.captain.learned.beas: %1$s of %2$s is back, clawed but not afraid of beasts any more, and runs with wolves now.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: You can't hide your ki from %s. He feels it from a mile off.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: Ki ya can't hide from %s. He feel it far.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s smells ki! Ya can't hide it from 'im!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: There's no hiding that much ki, %s.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: Oi! I can feel ya ki, %s!
Ya glowin' like a torch inside, %s!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s is sworn to his god. He's hard on anyone of another faith, but his own god's faithful hurt him.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s sworn to his god. Hate other gods' folk. His own god folk hurt him bad.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s is sworn to a god! Hates da other gods' lot! His own god's lot can hurt 'im though!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s wears bog iron. It's as good as iron, but it goes soft when he's wet.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s wear bog iron. Strong. Get wet, it go soft.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s wears bog iron! Get 'im wet an' it goes all soft!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s never sleeps. You won't catch him abed, and he keeps a watch all night.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s never sleep. No catch him in bed. Watch all night.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s never sleeps! Never! Watches all night, dat one!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s hates fire mages. He goes for them first and hits them harder.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s hate fire mage. Go for dem first. Hit hard.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s hates fire-throwers! Goes for 'em first, every time!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: You. The one with the fire, %s. You're first.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.talk.jaymoski: Ya burn me, %s? Now I burn you.
